messages:
anya: Heads-up: targeting a coordinated Py/TS SDK roll in ~25m. Patch scope: fix batching edge-case + tighten TS types. Plan: CI -> shadow publish to internal registry -> smoke installs -> flip public dist-tags & publish release notes. Will pin sync-client v2 as 'legacy-sync' dist-tag. Thoughts? :wave:

sam: 👍 fine by me. did we bump peer deps in TS package? last minute breakage from that before.

rachel: checking PR now. if engines/peerDeps changed we should include migration note. Also suggest we add a short troubleshooting snippet in release notes for common auth errors.

anya: good call. I'll add migration + auth troubleshooting bullets. starting local build and signing now.

deploy-bot: publish-flow initiated for thread 1788887777
status: building artifacts -> signing
commands run:
```
npm pack && tar -tf package.tgz
python -m build && gpg --detach-sign -a dist/*.whl
```

ops-bot: FYI last-night PyPI checksum mismatch incident tracked as INC-2026-48, recommend shadow publish first.

nina: agree with shadow. we'll validate via the internal index and then mirror to public indexes. saves us from emergency yanks.

anya: switching to shadow publish. uploading artifacts to internal-registry.redwood now. will post SHAs when done.

deploy-bot: artifacts uploaded to internal registry. SHAs: wheel sha256=ab12c3d4e5f67890b1c2d3e4f567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890, npm tgz sha1=9f8e7d6c5b4a3c2d1e

sam: installing from internal VM now for quick smoke: `npm i @redwood/sdk@file:registry-internal...` and `pip install --index-url https://internal... redwood-sdk==x.y.z`

deploy-bot: smoke VM tests: generator smoke ok, embeddings smoke ok, basic auth flow ok. 0/3 flaky.

rachel: awesome. I'll draft release notes and mark the sync-client deprecation (soft) with timeline and migration snippet.

nina: what's our rollback playbook if something slips after we flip tags?

anya: rollback plan (short): (1) restore npm dist-tag `stable` to previous version: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<prev> stable` and `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<prev> latest` if consumers rely on latest; (2) for PyPI, promote previous wheel from internal index to public or update our pointers; (3) post rollback + mitigation note in #general and escalate to support; (4) if code bug, open emergency patch PR with label:release-hotfix and coordinate next patch. Avoid unpublish unless legal/security reason.

ops-bot: runtime route fallback is available for 1h as safety net; ops will enable if errors spike > 5% in 10m window.

sam: please also include checksums & gpg signature in release notes so enterprise customers can verify quickly.

anya: will include checksums + gpg sig link. holding before public push for 20m internal observation window. posting final GO/NO-GO after timer. :coffee:

deploy-bot: internal-observation timer started (20m). will post results at completion.

rachel: prepping support blurb + upgrade steps. will attach to release notes PR.

anya: thanks all. if anyone sees anything in the next 20m ping me directly. otherwise we flip and ship the notes. :shipit:
